articles.title: Adrianna Smith named America East 2025-26 Female Scholar-Athlete of the Year

articles.title: Women's Basketball announces non-conference schedule

articles.title: Women's Basketball tabbed 7th in WBCA Academic Top 25 Team Honor Roll
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine -- The University of Maine women's basketball team checked in seventh in the 2025-26 Women's Basketball Coaches Association Academic Top 25 Team Honor Rolls, as announced by the WBCA on Tuesday, July 21. The Black Bears finished seventh among NCAA Division I members with a 3.777 cumulative team grade point average.

articles.title: Iliano and Tremblay Named Phil Steele Preseason All-Americans
articles.summary: It was announced on Monday that both Anthony Iliano and Samuel Tremblay of the University of Maine football program were named Phil Steele Preseason All-Americans. Iliano was named to the Third-Team for the second time this preseason (first by FCS Stats Perform) while Tremblay was named to the Fourth-Team for the first time in his career.
